zh-Hans:
• 重整 Skill Hub 首页，增加精选滚动卡与分类浏览，优化操作比例和行内多选。
• 统一技能检查与全部更新，保护预置技能，按实际备份显示回退。
• 增加官方技能精确依赖声明、环境准备与版本管理，保持基础镜像轻量。
• 按聊天、图片和视频用途整理供应商添加表单，保留已有配置与选择。
• 修复长输入展开、Kimi 工具调用命名和终端尺寸变化；增加工具调用准备状态。
• 拆分后台音频控制，完善后台工作会话、下载恢复及结束清理。
• 增加远端主机技能管理入口，以及图片结果保存到照片。
en-US:
• Redesigned Skill Hub discovery with featured cards, categories, compact actions and inline multiple selection.
• Unified update checks and Update All, protected bundled skills, and show rollback only when a real backup exists.
• Added exact dependency declarations, environment preparation and version management for reviewed official skills while keeping the base image lightweight.
• Organized provider forms by chat, image and video use, preserving existing settings and choices.
• Fixed long-input expansion, Kimi tool-call names and terminal resizing, and added a tool-call preparation state.
• Separated background audio controls and improved background work sessions, download recovery and cleanup.
• Added host-specific remote skill management and Save to Photos for image results.
